verdict.rationale: Coinbase's x402 docs describe an official Bazaar MCP server, which lets an MCP-compatible agent discover payable x402 services through tool calls. Sellers' endpoints are exposed to agents through it as well. The evidence covers only a few short mentions focused on discovery, and no hands-on test of the MCP server itself is recorded; the runtime probe exercised the REST discovery API, not MCP. Missing for 10: detailed MCP setup/connection docs, evidence that the MCP server covers payment execution beyond discovery, independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP server working.
